row.evidence: FastSpring's security settings guide says "FastSpring does not support SCIM provisioning. Users must already have a FastSpring account created before they can log in via Okta."
row.notes: New row. FastSpring (merchant of record) prices by a custom-quoted flat-rate revenue share with no public tiers or per-seat prices, and says it does not add fees per feature. Enterprise SSO is Okta OIDC only (via the OIN FastSpring app; Google sign-in is social and does not count); no plan gate is stated. Docs state SCIM is not supported and users must be created in the app first (no JIT). Team users are managed by Administrators in the app (add/invite, role per company or store, disable, reactivate). The public FastSpring API covers commerce objects (customer accounts, orders, subscriptions), not team users. Interactive Quotes (IQ) has its own team management.
